reason: The analyst's spec is thin: it controls only for size and age, omits lagged patents and the other 2020 covariates, trims the outcome without justification, and reports one specification. Still, the estimate of 0.73 (p=0.001) matches my full pre-period-control estimate of 0.75 (p=0.001). The positive conclusion also holds with full controls on the trimmed sample (0.67, p=0.003). The conclusion is supported, though it should be framed as a conditional association and not a proven causal effect.
